culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Sark, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visit Sark: the island is car-free. Visitors walk, cycle, take a horse-drawn carriage or the tractor bus. Keep left, and don't ride bicycles on footpaths or cliff paths.
culture-and-protocol.note: No official source read; the authority is named so it can be asked.
